# Validation report download

## Components

### Download report button

Also known as the "view validation report" button.

### Report download modal

This screen lets the user download the selected validation report in the format
and with the error-level they choose.

The UI spec suggests having the error-level options "full, errors, warnings",
but it'll be easier to use the same convention as the validation library uses,
which is to include either just errors or both errors and warnings. I don't
think users would want to see just warnings while ignoring the more serious
errors.

- format dropdown:
    - values: csv, yaml, json
- error-level dropdown:
    - decides the error-level
    - values: "warnings, errors" OR "all, errors only"
- download button:
    - initiates the download
- downloader (dcc.Download):
    - handles the actual file saving/download

## Implementation

### Stores

**memory**:
- `report-content: str`
- `report-download-modal-flag: bool`
- `selected-report-path: str`

### Callbacks

The report content has to be loaded into memory on the client-side before the
modal flag is set, so that the download-btn has content to process.

**download-report-btn.n_clicks (clientside)**:
- load `selected-report-path`'s file content into `report-content` from OPFS
  storage
- set report-download-modal-flag

**report-download-modal-flag.data**:
- set report-download-modal.is_shown

**report-download-modal**:
- **download-btn.n_clicks**:
    - read format from `format-dropdown`
    - read error-level from `error-level-dropdown`
    - call `odm_validation/tools/reportutils.write_<format>_report` with
      `report-content`
    - set `downloader.data` to the final formatted report data
    - reset report-download-modal-flag
